name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and cup the top end of one dumbbell with both palms.
Press the dumbbell straight overhead with your core braced and elbows pointing forward.
Bend both elbows under control to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend your elbows smoothly to lift the dumbbell back overhead.
tips: Keep the dumbbell securely cradled and your upper arms near your ears.
Keep your lower ribs tucked down instead of arching your lower back.
